name: TRICK 2022 "Best fishbowl" by Tomoya Ishida (tompng), MIT License: open /fishbowl in a browser
info:
TRICK 2022 "Best fishbowl" (Gold) by Tomoya Ishida (tompng)

Source: https://github.com/tric/trick2022/tree/main/01-tompng
The Ruby code in the ruby-wasm node is the entry copied unchanged.

An aquatic quine: every frame of the ASCII art fish tank is itself a Ruby program that resumes the animation from that frame.

Open http://<Node-RED host>:1880/fishbowl in a browser (with httpNodeRoot set, below it) and click Start.
- The ruby-wasm node runs in frame mode and keeps the latest frame in flow context
- The page asks GET fishbowl/frame for it about 7 times a second and redraws it
- POST fishbowl/start and fishbowl/stop start and stop the animation (msg.kill); it keeps running when the page is closed, until Stop
